title: Rabbi Yehudah ben Yair, a Tanna

paragraphs: [Yevamot 80b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.80b.4) mentions Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel reporting in his name. Some propose that he was Rabbi Pinchas ben Yair’s brother, but Hyman finds this very difficult: Rabbi Pinchas ben Yair was a colleague of Rabbi Yehudah HaNasi, so how could Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel report his brother?[^1]

notes.text: The linked baraita has Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel speak in Rabbi Yehudah ben Yair’s name. Hyman finds it very difficult, on chronological grounds, to identify Yehudah as Rabbi Pinchas ben Yair’s brother.
